\(A\) and \(B\) are \(4\) cm apart. The diagram shows a circle with centre \(A\) and radius \({@exd(r)@}\) cm, and the perpendicular bisector of \(AB\).

generalfeedback.text:
The required region is [[if test="is(ins=1)"]]inside the circle, where \(PA\) is less than \({@exd(r)@}\) cm[[else]]outside the circle, where \(PA\) is more than \({@exd(r)@}\) cm[[/if]], and the circle is drawn [[if test="is(solc=1)"]]solid, so it is included[[else]]dashed, so it is not included[[/if]]: \(PA\) [[if test="is(rl1=1)"]]\(\lt\)[[elif test="is(rl1=2)"]]\(\le\)[[elif test="is(rl1=3)"]]\(\gt\)[[else]]\(\ge\)[[/if]] \({@exd(r)@}\) cm.

The required region is on [[if test="is(asd=1)"]]\(A\)'s side of the bisector, where \(P\) is nearer to \(A\)[[else]]\(B\)'s side of the bisector, where \(P\) is nearer to \(B\)[[/if]], and the bisector is drawn [[if test="is(soll=1)"]]solid, so it is included[[else]]dashed, so it is not included[[/if]]: \(PA\) [[if test="is(rl2=1)"]]\(\lt\)[[elif test="is(rl2=2)"]]\(\le\)[[elif test="is(rl2=3)"]]\(\gt\)[[else]]\(\ge\)[[/if]] \(PB\).

questiondescription.text:
Loci: describing a region with inequalities

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.3: Describe a region bounded by a circle and a perpendicular bisector with inequalities, using solid and dashed boundaries.

falsefeedback.text: Decide the direction from the side the unshaded region is on, then the strictness from the line style.
